feeds.title: Safe Horizon
feeds.description: Safe Horizon is an organization that helps victims of interpersonal crime and abuse. Their programs and services focus on individuals affected by domestic violence, child abuse, rape and sexual assault, crime, human trafficking, and stalking, as well as homeless youth and families of homicide victims.

feeds.title: WINGS Program News
feeds.description: The mission of WINGS Program, Inc. is to provide housing, integrated services, education, and advocacy to end domestic violence. It is committed to treating each woman and child in a respectful manner while valuing the unique qualities and needs of each family. This blog will provide the latest news and updates about the WINGS Program.

feeds.title: The National Domestic Violence Hotline News
feeds.description: The Hotline has become one of the leading expert organizations on domestic violence in the nation. They support, resources & hope for anyone affected by domestic violence in the United States.

feeds.title: Our VOICE Blog
feeds.description: Our VOICE, Inc. is a non-profit crisis intervention and prevention agency which serves victims and Supporting Survivors of Rape and Sexual Assault in Asheville and Buncombe County.

feeds.title: The DV Walking Wounded Blog
feeds.description: The Walking Wounded is just an inspirational page for survivors of domestic and sexual abuse. This page is for survivors and victims alike, as well as their support squad - we pray and are working toward a world without abuse of ANY kind.

feeds.title: Pennsylvania Coalition Against Domestic Violence Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1976, PCADV is the oldest statewide domestic violence coalition in the nation. Each year, its network of 59 local domestic violence programs provides free and confidential direct services to nearly 90,000 victims and survivors of domestic violence and their children in all 67 counties of the Commonwealth. The PCADV blog chronicles the lastest happenings in research, legislation, and advocacy related to domestic violence.

feeds.title: End Domestic Abuse Wisconsin
feeds.description: For advocates, survivors, & allies, End Domestic Abuse Wisconsin (End Abuse) is the only statewide coalition led by social policy advocates, attorneys, & experts working to support, connect, equip, empower, & lead social change organizations to end domestic abuse - because everyone deserves dignity & safety.

feeds.title: Domestic Violence Services Network Blog
feeds.description: Check-in monthly for updates on DVSN programs, services, & events. Plus, information & commentary about domestic violence issues, news, and related subjects. Domestic Violence Services Network, Inc. (DVSN) works in collaboration with communities to end domestic violence. We strive to empower and educate all peoples in ways that respect their dignity and choices while promoting their safety.

feeds.title: Domestic Abuse Commissioner Blog
feeds.description: The Domestic Abuse Commissioner is an independent voice that speaks on behalf of victims and survivors. The Domestic Abuse Commissioner shines a spotlight on the issues that affect all survivors and victims of domestic abuse. Please stay up-to-date with their latest news, media statements, and blog posts. Their blog covers import topics such as domestic abuse cases, victim stories, healing material, community help, legal information, Guidance on the recovery process for survivors and more.

feeds.title: UK Says No More Blog
feeds.description: UK SAYS NO MORE seeks to unite and strengthen a diverse community of members and organizations nationwide to actively take a stand against domestic abuse and sexual violence under one powerful, visual symbol. The campaign provides open-source tools and resources for individuals and organizations to take action and get involved in making a difference. The blog features the latest news, opinion pieces, and partnership announcements.

feeds.title: The Sun
feeds.description: Articles in this section cover the topic of Domestic Violence. Browse Public and Personal stories, essays, and memoirs depicting instances of Domestic Violence and Help cases. The Sun is an independent, reader-supported magazine featuring some of the most radically intimate and socially conscious writing being published today.

feeds.title: REACH Blog
feeds.description: REACH provides survivors of domestic violence with safety, shelter, and a path to healing. Our innovative, community-based approach promotes healthy relationships, fosters collaboration, and empowers community members to be agents of change.

feeds.title: The Law Offices of Matthew M. Fakhoury Blog
feeds.description: When you're facing domestic violence charges in Chicago, you need tough legal representation to preserve your rights and help ensure that your side of the story comes out in court. The Law Offices of Matthew M. Fakhoury, LLC represents clients in all facets of criminal law, including domestic battery and orders of protection.

feeds.title: Scottish Women's Aid Blog
feeds.description: Scottish Women's Aid is the lead organization in Scotland working towards the prevention of domestic abuse. We play a vital role in coordinating, influencing, and campaigning for effective responses to domestic abuse. We work with a network of 34 specialists local Women's Aid groups toward a shared vision of a Scotland where domestic abuse is not tolerated.

feeds.title: Washington State Coalition Against Domestic Violence
feeds.description: WSCADV is the leading voice to end domestic violence in Washington State. We improve how communities respond to domestic violence and are working to create a world where all people can live and love without fear. WSCADV is a resource for programs that assist domestic violence survivors and their families. Our work includes research, training, producing educational tools, engaging the public to prevent domestic violence, and policy advocacy.

feeds.title: Helping Services for Youth & Families » Domestic Abuse Advocacy
feeds.description: Since 1973, Helping Services for Youth & Families (formerly Helping Services for Northeast Iowa) has been providing children, teens, and adults with the skills and knowledge to bring about positive change in their own lives and in their communities.

feeds.title: Sharon Bryan Blog
feeds.description: For the last 24 years, Sharon has worked in the field of domestic abuse. Starting out as a volunteer for a local refuge service, she went on to secure a full-time job for the same service. Sharon Bryan specializes in survivor consultation and intervention, risk assessment, facilitation of The Freedom Programme, and Multi-Agency training.

feeds.title: Domestic Violence & Sexual Assault Center Blog
feeds.description: At Domestic Violence & Sexual Assault Center, our mission is to protect victims, prevent violence, and empower survivors. The main goals are to ensure safety, increase awareness, financial support, and much more.

feeds.title: David's Corner
feeds.description: David Wankovsky is a blogger who writes about domestic violence, child abuse, etc and shares about different stories and experiences through his blog.

feeds.title: Sanctuary for the Abused
feeds.description: Articles and resources for victims & survivors. Dealing with verbal, psychological & emotional abuse and personality disorders.

feeds.title: en(gender)ed
feeds.description: en(gender)ed features stories that explore the systems, practices, and policies that enable gender-based violence and oppression and the solutions to end it. We teach feminism and decolonize hearts and minds, one story at a time.

feeds.title: FindingDina
feeds.description: I am a domestic abuse survivor. I was with my abuser for almost 7 years. I am blogging about my abuse and my journey of finding myself and happiness again.

feeds.title: Center for Community Solutions
feeds.description: Center for Community Solutions wants to eliminate relationship and sexual violence by being a catalyst for caring communities and social justice. Each year, CCS assists tens of thousands of women, children and men affected by relationship violence and sexual assault.

feeds.title: Premier Domestic Violence Law Group Blog
feeds.description: Features articles that have to do exclusively with Domestic Violence Law. At Premier Domestic Violence Law Group, based in San Diego, we offer defense representation from a former senior domestic violence prosecutor who understands all facets of these cases.

feeds.title: [NAME REDACTED] Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm [NAME REDACTED] I am a domestic violence survivor. I am creating a blog as a way to process my experience and hopefully someone else can gain some insight by this whole thing. I am going to be ambiguous about a few specifics on purpose, I don't want this blog to be all about me haha I know it sounds silly. I want this blog to be one anonymous story. This could easily happen to your little sister, your daughter, your best friend, any woman you see or meet anywhere.

feeds.title: Freedom Within: My Journey through Domestic Violence & PTSD
feeds.description: I am a Domestic Violence Survivor, living with PTSD and through this blog I'm sharing my experience to help others.

feeds.title: Get Domestic Violence Help Blog
feeds.description: Get domestic violence help now or learn how to empower another who is suffering domestic abuse by learning more about it.

feeds.title: Not An Option
feeds.description: Journey to Recovery, Peace, and Awareness.

feeds.title: Ogbongematters
feeds.description: This blog helps to know about the different kinds of abuses and relationships.

feeds.title: Dear J. Doe
feeds.description: Support blog for all victims/survivors of sexual assault, molestation, incest, domestic violence, and abusive relationships.

feeds.title: Rescued for His Kingdom
feeds.description: Rescued for His Kingdom is a blog that brings support to victims and survivors of domestic violence. We believe sharing our stories can empower and bring light to survivors & victims of domestic violence.

feeds.title: Swearing Totally Helps Blog
feeds.description: Personal and informative stories about domestic violence and other forms of abuse with a light gentle snarky vibe to get us through it all.

feeds.title: Family Lawyer Magazine » Domestic Violence
feeds.description: FamilyLawyerMagazine.com is an online portal dedicated to helping family lawyers and other family law professionals in the U.S. and Canada to excel in their practice. Here, seasoned professionals in the family law arena share their best practice management and client-relations advice, read about new technology and financial issues, and learn how to grow their firms.

feeds.title: Illinois Coalition Against Domestic Violence Blog
feeds.description: The Illinois Coalition Against Domestic Violence (ICADV) is a statewide voice for survivors of domestic violence and their children. With over 50 member organizations providing direct service to survivors, together we work towards ending domestic violence in Illinois.

feeds.title: Louisiana Coalition Against Domestic Violence
feeds.description: The Louisiana Coalition Against Domestic Violence is the federally designated statewide coalition of shelters, non-residential programs, and individuals working to end domestic violence in Louisiana. Our programs serve people from everywhere in Louisiana and who come from all backgrounds. We oppose violence as a means of control over others and support equality in relationships.

feeds.title: Utah Domestic Violence Coalition
feeds.description: Utah Domestic Violence Coalition is a private non-profit organization recognized nationally for providing expertise concerning issues of domestic and sexual violence to member programs, community partners, and others in Utah. Our mission is to end domestic violence in Utah through advocacy, education, collaboration, and leadership.

feeds.title: Womenlines » Let's Erase Domestic Violence
feeds.description: Womenlines is an e-Magazine promoting business, leadership, and health excellence for busy women professionals and entrepreneurs globally so they can be the best version of themselves. Womenlines runs talk shows and publishes content shared by experts from across the globe on topics like business excellence, leadership skills, and a healthy you. In the following section read articles empowering women to erase domestic violence.

feeds.title: AVDA Blog
feeds.description: AVDA is a nonprofit organization that has served the Houston community for 40 years with the mission to end family violence by advocating for the safety and self-determination of victims, promoting accountability for abusers and fostering a community response to abuse. AVDA is dedicated to providing multilingual, transformational, life saving services to survivors of abuse and their families.

feeds.title: Rise Magazine » Domestic Violence
feeds.description: Witnessing violence at home harms children, and children often enter foster care because of violence at home. Rise stories explore the controlling patterns of batterers, the fights that flare up under stress, and the aggression driven by mental illness or substance abuse. Parents describe the steps they have taken to break free of violence and help themselves and their children recover.

feeds.title: Haven Hills Blog
feeds.description: Since 1977 Haven Hills has lifted up survivors of domestic violence to transform their lives. We offer shelter, crisis intervention, counseling, advocacy, and activities supporting increased economic opportunity for over 2,500 women and men each year. In doing so, we help survivors of domestic violence find the strength within themselves to break the cycle of abuse and build a new, productive, and joyful life for themselves and their children.

feeds.title: Women's Aid Blog
feeds.description: Women's Aid is a grassroots federation working together to provide life-saving services in England and build a future where domestic abuse is not tolerated. We're working together against domestic abuse until women and children are safe. Women's Aid Blog is a useful source of information for women facing problems as the helpful and ifnrotmive articles can come in handy for them if they face any problem in the future as the bog covers topics related to domestic abuse, safety measure, toxic culture, mental health, healing stories and more.

feeds.title: The Hotline
feeds.description: NCADV is the voice of victims and survivors. We are the catalyst for changing society to have zero tolerance for domestic violence. We do this by affecting public policy, increasing understanding of the impact of domestic violence, and providing programs and education that drive that change.

feeds.title: Create Soul Space
feeds.description: Covers articles about support, education, and awareness of intimate partner violence (IPV), with an empathetic spiritual twist, and helping to break free of narcissistic abuse and creating the space to become you again.

feeds.title: NO MORE
feeds.description: NO MORE provides access to informational resources - Educating and promoting awareness of social issues - Advocating for greater action to end domestic violence and sexual assault.

feeds.title: BWJP
feeds.description: The BWJP Criminal and Civil Justice Office focuses on how effective intervention requires inter-agency coordination and policy development that guides individual practitioners in the use of arrest, prosecution, sentencing, victim safeguards, and batterers' intervention programs.

feeds.title: Move to End Violence
feeds.description: Move to End Violence, a 10 year program of the NoVo Foundation, is designed to strengthen our collective capacity to end violence against girls and women in the United States.

feeds.title: Futures Without Violence Blog
feeds.description: From domestic and dating violence, to child abuse and sexual assault, Futures Without Violence, formerly Family Violence Prevention Fund, works to end some of the most pressing global issues of our time. Follow the blog to learn more about their work to prevent violence by building healthier relationships and communities.

feeds.title: My Story of Domestic Abuse
feeds.description: Domestic Abuse be it physical or emotional isn't the greatest place to get yourself in and I should know because I've been there. This is the story of my long tough 28-year journey through it and the recovery from it. Why share my story? The answer for me is a simple one, I decided not to be the quite submissive victim anymore.

feeds.title: YWCA USA Blog
feeds.description: YWCA USA helps to eliminate racism, empower women, stand up for social justice, help families, and strengthen communities.

feeds.title: South Carolina Coalition Against Domestic Violence & Sexual Assault
feeds.description: Since 1981, SCCADVASA has been a leader in representing the critical needs of survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault and is a pivotal voice in violence prevention. We advance our work through advocacy, education, and collaboration. Through advocacy, collaboration, and prevention education, we can provide equitable resources and inspire transformative cultural change.

feeds.title: Genesis Women's Shelter & Support Blog
feeds.description: Genesis's core mission is to empower women and children by offering safety, shelter, and support. In that same regard, we strive to create a workplace as diverse as the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to be their full, authentic selves.

feeds.title: Day One Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles on various problems faced by people in the society. Day One's mission is to partner with youth to end dating abuse, racial abuse and domestic violence through community education, supportive services, legal advocacy and leadership development.

feeds.title: Diaries From Domestic Violence Blog
feeds.description: Share in the story.......

feeds.title: SafeLives
feeds.description: SafeLives is the UK-wide charity dedicated to ending domestic abuse, for everyone and for good. They work with organizations across the UK to transform the response to domestic abuse. Visit their Practice blog to know more about the charity, their services, past work, feature stories, community news, updates and more useful information.
